name: diet
description: Route the mechanical parts of a session to cheaper models: a bulk-reader for large-file reads (Sonnet, per the measurements in the README), a Haiku code-writer for mirror-pattern code from a required reference file, and a PreToolUse hook that keeps unfiltered command payloads out of the session - rewriting the command in place where the fix is mechanical, and denying with the fix in the message only where narrowing needs a decision it cannot make.
